As an IT Specialist (System Analysis) "Product Manager", GS-2210-15, you will be responsible for: Leading the definition and evolution of FSA products by understanding the needs of students, families, and stakeholders, translating insights into prioritized product roadmaps, and ensuring product decisions improve access to aid and simplify the user experience.

Serving as the bridge between policy goals, technical systems, and user needs by translating complex constraints into actionable requirements and ensuring solutions meet compliance and security standards while delivering user-friendly experiences at national scale.

Directing and aligning contractors and partner agencies to support the product vision, holding vendors accountable for outcomes, and fostering collaboration across engineering, design, policy, and operations teams to deliver a coherent, high-quality FSA experience.

Connecting day-to-day work to the mission of expanding educational opportunity, fostering a product culture centered on experimentation, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement, and providing vision that aligns government staff and vendors around shared goals for students and families.

Applying deep experience building and managing products at scale to ensure FSA systems deliver secure, reliable, and seamless experiences while protecting sensitive data and maintaining public trust.
Minimum Qualification Requirements You may meet the minimum qualifications for the GS-15, if you possess the specialize experience.

Specialized Experience for the GS-15: One year of experience in either federal or non-federal service that is equivalent to at least a GS-14 performing two (2) out of three (3) of the following duties or work assignments: Experience serving as the product leader in the development of a scaled technology platform.

Experience serving as a product manager, overseeing internal and external software development, testing, integration, and operation. Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences and translating business requirements into technical user stories.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs) The quality of your experience will be measured by the extent to which you possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities (KSAs).

You do not need to provide separate narrative responses to these KSAs, as they will be measured by your responses to the occupational questionnaire (you may preview the occupational questionnaire by clicking the link at the end of the Evaluations section of this vacancy announcement).

Knowledge of product management principles, with a focus on user-centered design and measurable outcomes. Skill in translating policy and technical requirements into intuitive, scalable product solutions. Skill in managing vendors and cross-functional teams to deliver results and drive tangible product improvements.

Ability to inspire and sustain a mission-driven product culture. Knowledge of building and operating large-scale, mission-critical systems or comparable technology infrastructure.

The eRA Product Manager within Notre Dame Research serves as the strategic owner of the University’s electronic Research Administration (eRA) ecosystem. This position is responsible for the vision, roadmap, governance, and lifecycle management of the administrative systems that support the University’s research enterprise.

The eRA Product Manager partners closely with Notre Dame Research Administration and Compliance, Campus IT, and external software vendors to ensure research administration and compliance platforms align with institutional priorities, federal compliance requirements, and the evolving needs of faculty and research staff.

In this role, the eRA Product Manager acts as a high-level consultant to University leadership, translating strategic research objectives into scalable technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, data integrity, compliance readiness, and proposal competitiveness.

Most immediately, the successful candidate in collaboration with the Associate Vice President of Research and the Director of Research Effectiveness and Analytics will play a defining leadership role in steering the University through a major eRA implementation, shaping the future of Notre Dame’s research infrastructure from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities Define, manage, and execute the product roadmap for the University’s electronic Research Administration systems, prioritizing enhancements and feature releases that streamline workflows and reduce administrative burden.

Serve as the primary liaison between Notre Dame Research Administration and Compliance, Campus IT, and third-party software vendors to advocate for institutional needs and influence product development.

Lead system governance and integration strategy for research administration platforms, ensuring effective data exchange between eRA systems, HRIS, ERP, and other enterprise applications. Oversee research data governance practices to establish consistent standards, improve data quality, and support reliable institutional reporting and analytics.

Configure and maintain system validations and workflows to support evolving federal regulations and sponsor requirements, including NSF, NIH, USDA, and other compliance standards. Collaborate with leadership and stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and enhanced reporting capabilities.

Develop and maintain system documentation, business processes, and training materials to support successful adoption of system enhancements and transitions. Lead “train-the-trainer” initiatives and support change management efforts across the research community.

Monitor system performance, user feedback, and emerging industry trends to inform continuous improvement efforts. Support reporting and data visualization activities to translate research administration data into actionable insights for leadership decision-making.

Support audit readiness activities by ensuring accurate system configurations, data integrity, and compliance documentation. Participate in vendor user groups, professional organizations, and research administration communities to stay informed on best practices and emerging technologies.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Research Administration, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in research administration, enterprise systems management, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in a leadership, Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar strategic systems role.

Experience supporting enterprise-level software implementations, preferably within research administration, ERP, or higher education environments. Expert understanding of the research grant lifecycle, including pre-award, post-award, and compliance functions.

Strong understanding of enterprise systems architecture, integrations, and data governance principles. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct supervisory authority. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and identify operational trends.

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences, including faculty and senior leadership. Ability to balance strategic planning with operational execution in a dynamic environment. Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail and compliance requirements.

Preferred qualifications Experience working within higher education research administration environments. Familiarity with eRA systems, ERP platforms, and SaaS-to-on-premises data integrations. Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Knowledge of federal research compliance regulations and sponsored program administration. Please include a cover letter and resume to be considered for this role. Salary up to $113,500, commensurate with experience. Applications due by July 27 2026.

The University of Notre Dame seeks to attract, develop, and retain the highest quality faculty, staff and administration. The University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or age in employment.

Moreover, Notre Dame prohibits discrimination against veterans or disabled qualified individuals, and complies with 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-300.5(a). We strongly encourage applications from candidates attracted to a university with a Catholic identity.

The University of Notre Dame is more than a workplace; it is a vibrant, mission-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit.

Here, you will find a deep sense of belonging, a culture that prioritizes well-being, and the opportunity to grow your career while being a force for good in the world.

Whether contributing to world-class research, shaping the student experience, or supporting the University’s mission in other ways, you will be part of a dedicated team working to make a meaningful impact on campus and beyond. At Notre Dame, your work matters, and so do you! Originally posted on Himalayas

About CrackaJack Digital Solutions: Since 2016, CrackaJack Digital Solutions has empowered small to mid-sized businesses to thrive through digital transformation. We provide the global expertise needed to navigate today's complex technology landscape. We've evolved beyond traditional IT to become a specialized partner in high-impact security and compliance, with core expertise spanning:
· GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance): Strategic alignment and regulatory mastery
· Identity & Access Management (IAM): Precision control over resource access
· Cybersecurity & Penetration Testing: Proactive defense and vulnerability neutralization
· Data Privacy: Global protection for your most sensitive assets
· Managed IT & Infrastructure: Scalable solutions and technical staffing talent From cloud infrastructure to web development, we deliver practical, data-driven technology tailored to our clients' growth. Mission: To inspire and transform businesses through digital innovations that accelerate long-term, sustainable revenue growth. Vision: To be a global leader in impactful digital IT transformation and cybersecurity excellence. Purpose: Listen & Understand · Lead with Data · Leverage Expertise About the Role: CrackaJack is looking for an Associate Product Manager to support the planning, coordination, and continuous improvement of client digital transformation and security engagements, spanning cloud infrastructure, application development, and GRC/IAM/cybersecurity workstreams. What You'll Do: Delivery & Execution
· Support senior PMs and delivery leads in planning, scoping, and executing client digital transformation projects.
· Translate client requirements into user stories, epics, and technical specifications for engineering teams.
· Maintain and track roadmaps, backlogs, sprints, and delivery timelines across distributed teams.
· Facilitate stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and status updates.
· Identify risks, blockers, and scope changes early, and escalate appropriately.
· Prepare client-facing status reports, project documentation, and presentations. Product Input & Offering Improvement
· Gather and synthesize feedback from clients and delivery teams after engagements, and turn it into concrete recommendations for improving how our GRC, IAM, PenTest, Cybersecurity, and Managed IT offerings are scoped and packaged.
· Contribute to defining offering documentation scope, deliverables, target client profile, and delivery timelines — for at least one or two practice areas.
· Conduct light competitive and market research on how comparable IT/security consultancies package similar services, and bring back actionable input for practice leads.
· Help prioritize a simple backlog of offering and process improvements, working with practice leads across GRC, IAM, PenTest, Cybersecurity, and Managed IT. What We're Looking For:
· 1–3 years of experience in a product management, project coordination, business analyst, or related delivery role (internships and equivalent experience considered).
· Basic understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile/Scrum preferred).
· Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.
· Clear written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to clients and stakeholders.
· Analytical mindset comfortable doing light market/competitive research and turning client feedback into clear recommendations.
· Ability to work effectively across time zones with distributed, global teams.
· Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have:
· Exposure to GRC, IAM, cybersecurity, or data privacy concepts, or compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, HIPAA, GDPR).
· Experience working with or supporting cloud infrastructure or web/mobile development projects.
· Prior experience in an IT consulting or professional services environment.
· Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, Notion, or similar. Why CrackaJack
· Build core PM fundamentals (backlog management, sprint execution, stakeholder communication) while also getting real input into product/offering decisions not just coordination work.
· Direct visibility into and mentorship from company leadership, including our Co-Founder & Managing Director and VP of Global Talent Services.
· Exposure to a broad range of cutting-edge domains: GRC, IAM, penetration testing, data privacy, cloud infrastructure, and AI consulting. CrackaJack Digital Solutions LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Originally posted on Himalayas

You'll work at the intersection of design, product management, and user research, bridging the gap between business requirements and seamless digital experiences. Key Responsibilities Ensure a well-thought-out and functional product. Translate into design for development.

A strategic approach to design—thinking beyond aesthetics to consider usability, accessibility, and business impact. At IONOS, the leading European provider of cloud infrastructure, cloud services and hosting services, you will work together with a wide range of teams. We are characterized by open structures, a friendly working culture and flat hierarchies with a strong team spirit. We firmly believe that work and fun are compatible, and offer you the right environment for this. Our constant growth means that we are always looking for new colleagues. Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

We are a modern e-commerce division responsible for the international online presence of currently 7 brands within the IONOS Group, making it one of the most important sales channels for our company. We work both in agile, cross-functional, and interdisciplinary teams, as well as in combination with agile project management for larger, complex initiatives and projects.

If you enjoy taking responsibility and want to help shape the online presence of tomorrow with us, you are exactly right here!

Tasks

· As a Product Owner, you will take end-to-end responsibility for a product area of our websites and online shops or for a brand within the IONOS Group, collaborating with cross-functional experts.

· As the person responsible for the conversion rate, you will continuously analyze and interpret user flows on the portal and in the checkout funnel.

· Continuously monitor the key KPIs of our main websites and online shops, providing analysis and reports for management.

· You will create and prioritize your backlog of improvements based on user feedback, business goals, and market insights, and align this with stakeholders.

· Conduct methodological analyses, such as market and competitive assessments, to identify user needs, trends, and opportunities for further development.

· You have the ability to translate complex user and business requirements from various stakeholders in the company into seamless workflows and conceptual ideas.

· Work closely in cross-functional collaboration and align with all relevant interfaces (development, technology, agencies, product management, product marketing, sales, customer service, etc.).

· You are familiar with current UX design trends and are interested in innovative concepts. You can effectively communicate and advocate for new ideas and concepts within the team and among our stakeholders.

· You are a passionate Product Owner and know what you want. The needs of our users drive you. Your foundation for success is a successful degree or equivalent education. You are familiar with the pros and cons of classical and agile methodologies through several years of practical experience, ideally in software development.

· You bring the right mix of creativity and entrepreneurial thinking.

· You are characterized by analytical thinking, a lot of initiative, commitment, courage, and a structured but pragmatic approach.

· You are experienced in working with stakeholders, as well as in creating epics and user stories, and in managing and prioritizing the product backlog.

· You collaboratively develop the product vision with stakeholders and bring it to life.

· Passion for digital innovation and a strong interest in new technologies and trends.

· Ability to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and quickly adapt to changing priorities and requirements.

· Personally, you are known for your quality awareness, willingness to perform, and initiative.

· You enjoy technical topics and digital products.

· Proficient in tools like G-Suite, Microsoft Office, Atlassian/JIRA, or Confluence.

· We work in an international company, so you have no problems communicating effectively in written and spoken English and German!

· Hybrid working model with Home office option.

· Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.

· At some locations, a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.

· Modern office space with very good transport connections.

· Various employee discounts for activities and products.

· Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.

· Numerous training and development opportunities.

· Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

About IONOS

IONOS is the leading European digitalization partner for small and medium-sized businesses (SMB). The company serves around six million customers and operates across 18 markets in Europe and North America, with its services being accessible worldwide.

With its Web Presence & Productivity portfolio, IONOS acts as a 'one-stop shop' for all digitalization needs: from domains and web hosting to classic website builders and do-it-yourself solutions, from e-commerce to online marketing tools.

In addition, the company offers Cloud Solutions to enterprises who are looking to move to the cloud as their businesses evolve.

We value diversity and welcome all applications - regardless of, for example, gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity, physical characteristics, marital status or any other irrelevant factor subject to applicable law.

s.t:

💰 We have provided over $3bn of funding to small businesses so far

Liberis is in the middle of a meaningful shift. We started as a single-product business and are quickly becoming a truly multi-product embedded finance company, with different funding structures, revenue models and customer relationships sitting alongside each other in the same portfolio. That complexity creates real demand for better data, better insight and clearer thinking about how all of it fits together - with this role sitting at the centre of that challange!

As our Senior Data Product Manager, you’ll sit right at the intersection of product, analytics, engineering and senior leadership, helping define the data products that power smarter decisions across Liberis.

You’ll have real ownership over roadmap, prioritisation and ways of working, and your work will directly influence how teams access, understand and use data day to day. This role is a high-impact opportunity for someone who wants to shape how a business uses data at scale!

You’ll be joining a team with a broad remit and a genuine mandate to improve the data experience across the company, so there’s a lot of scope to make the role your own and shape the future of the domain.

You will own the data and insights product for Liberis, building the foundations that let our commercial, credit and operations teams actually understand the business they're running.

That means, thinking carefully about the entities in our data model, how products and customers relate to each other, how those relationships surface in reporting and analysis - and how it eventually all comes out in great dashboards, tools and self-serve capabilities.

This is about shipping products which are genuinely useful, not just technically correct.

Our Engineering Team is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. Data, insights and analytics are a crucial part of that journey and you will be a key player in leading, innovating and rapidly improving our posture and capabilities at the intersection of data and AI.

If you like solving genuinely hard problems, bringing clarity to complex environments and building products that have visible business impact - this is the role for you!

Your primary job is to help Liberis's commercial decision makers understand the small businesses we serve and how they consider, use and perform across our product range. Doing this well requires a clear conceptual model of the business and a willingness to engage with stakeholders across the business, as well as taste and customer empathy in developing a great insights product including dashboards, insight tools and self-serve capabilities.

You will own the roadmap for our internal data & insight products. Working with stakeholders across commercial, credit, finance and operations, you will define what good looks like and then work with your team to build it. You will run prioritisation, manage the backlog and make decisions about where effort goes.

You will also spend a meaningful amount of time in the detail, reviewing data models and dashboards, asking hard questions about definitions, and making sure what we ship is accurate and trusted.

You will partner closely with the engineering side of your team on how data is modelled and structured in BigQuery and DBT, and with analysts on how it gets presented in Looker. You don't need to write production code, but you need enough technical understanding to be a genuine partner in those conversations. You will also be responsible for continuing to expand our partner-facing reporting, whereby partners gain visibility into their portfolio.

This role requires someone who can think clearly about complex data structures and translate that thinking into products that non-technical people actually find useful. The ideal person has strong conceptual thinking skills, great product instincts and enough technical depth to earn the trust of the engineers and analysts they work with.

· Proven experience in a senior data product or analytics product role in a business with real complexity

· A track record of helping commercial teams make better decisions through better data, not just shipping dashboards

· Strong ability to think about entities, taxonomies and relationships in data

· Hands-on experience with Looker and LookML and familiarity with best practices and scalable approaches to these systems

· Working knowledge of SQL, DBT and BigQuery, enough to engage seriously with how data is modelled and what's feasible, and to express your thinking in code-speak where needed

· Experience working with a multi skilled team of analysts and data engineers

· Clear, confident communication with senior commercial stakeholders

Next steps If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on

Our hybrid approach

Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week, but ideally 4 days. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

About Numan
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values:

· Patients first.

· Learn fast.

· Own the quality.

· Succeed together.

· Care deeply.
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

This role is about taking our platform to the next level: moving toward sophisticated, predictive, and learning-based decisioning, with a clear path toward becoming a regulated medical device.
This is a senior, high-impact individual contributor (IC) role for someone who combines deep system understanding with clinical product judgement and real experience deploying AI/ML. You are AI-enabled, well-resourced, and measure your success by what you ship and move, rather than the size of your team. You move comfortably between high-level strategy and engineering-grade specifics.

Lead the product direction and roadmap for the decision platform, from long-term strategy down to the detail of how a rule actually works.
Decide which features and capabilities create the most scalable value, balancing near-term execution with strategic bets.
Establish and systematically track the success metrics for the platform.
Set the direction for how the platform uses AI and machine learning, embedding predictive and supervised learning systems into production.
Build self-learning systems so the platform continuously improves on its historical recommendations while keeping safety and explainability central.
Read and reason about system architecture. Act as a credible equal in technical debates with engineers, making sharp trade-offs between speed-to-value and long-term scalability.
Help shape the product side of the platform's regulatory direction, including the decision to build it as Software/AI as a Medical Device (SaMD).
Work fluently with sensitive patient data, partnering with clinical and quality colleagues to ensure safety and patient trust fundamentally shape the roadmap.
Proactively show engineering, clinical, design, and other product teams what the platform makes possible, while staying pragmatic about what they can absorb today.

A proven track record as a Senior or Principal Technical PM on complex platform, infrastructure, or systems products.
Hands-on experience deploying machine learning in production, specifically supervised learning or predictive systems.
Experience deploying or regulating software/AI as a medical device (SaMD), or working within closely comparable regulated frameworks.
Direct experience working with rules engines, knowledge graphs, or AI-driven decisioning systems.
Experience in clinical, healthcare, or adjacent domains handling sensitive, highly detailed user data.
Experience operating as a high-velocity individual contributor who leverages AI tools to cover ground that would traditionally require multiple people.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Fuel and energy are among the largest controllable costs any fleet carries, yet most operators still make those decisions with partial data and disconnected tools. Samsara already sees how these fleets actually run and that data is the raw material for a new generation of cost-optimization products.
As a Senior Product Manager on this team, you'll own a product area end to end and turn that operational data into products the world's largest fleets rely on to cut fuel spend, run more efficiently, and navigate the shift to electric. Our portfolio spans fuel cost optimization (fuel cards, bulk fuel, partner programs), driver and vehicle efficiency, EVs and energy transition, as well as operational cost intelligence.
The exact area you own will be shaped by your strengths and where the team needs you most at the time of joining. In every case, you'll work at the intersection of operational data, financial outcomes, and fleet performance, partnering closely with engineering, design, data science, business development, and go-to-market to ship products that turn Samsara's telematics platform into a cost-optimization and energy-management engine for the world's largest fleets.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You want your work to move the physical economy: The products you ship will help real fleets spend less on fuel, waste less energy, and keep goods and people moving.

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Join the team working on the Mail & Calendar ecosystem alongside 50 Engineers

Developing innovative productivity tools that seamlessly integrate with our privacy-centric ecosystem.
Advancing the frontiers of cryptography to ensure user data remains secure even in the face of emerging technologies such as quantum proof encryption.
Expanding Proton's reach into the B2B segment, bringing privacy and security to businesses worldwide.

You are versatile in product-led growth, at the heart of our freemium model.
Work with the senior leadership team to define a strategic vision and roadmap
Drive product innovation, develop novel, game-changing product features that expand our value proposition to new user segments and increase our defensibility.

Facilitate hand-in-hand collaboration between product, engineering, growth and marketing to align on the vision and the execution.

Anticipate growth ceilings and define scaling strategies to prevent them, that include managing projects beyond pure-product work, and include foundational technology, tools, and processes, such as a customer engagement platform.

6 -10 years of experience in product management in B2C or B2B SaaS, preferably in online privacy and/or productivity contexts.

About The Opportunity
OKX is expanding its presence across Latin America, and we're looking for a locally embedded Product Manager to drive market growth in the region. This role sits at the intersection of local market strategy and product execution — you'll identify business and product opportunities unique to LatAm, shape how we localize the trading experience, and own the end-to-end user trading journey for the region.
This is not a "translate and ship" role. We need someone who deeply understands how LatAm users discover, onboard, trade, and grow — and who can turn that understanding into product decisions that move our regional metrics.
What You’ll Be Doing
Local Market Opportunity & Strategy
Identify and prioritize business and product opportunities specific to Latin American markets, including regional payment rails, local trading behaviors, regulatory nuances, and competitive gaps.
Build and maintain a deep understanding of the LatAm crypto and fintech landscape — including key competitors, user segments, regulatory trends, and macro factors that influence trading adoption.
Develop go-to-market product strategies tailored to LatAm user segments (e.g., first-time crypto users, active retail traders, remittance-driven users).
Partner with regional BD, marketing, and operations teams to align product initiatives with local growth objectives.
User Trading Journey Ownership
Own and optimize the full user trading journey across APP and WEB — from discovery and onboarding (Markets, Chart analysis) through execution (Order placement, Chart trading, Position management) to post-trade review (Asset analysis, Trading journal).
Define and execute the product roadmap for trading experience improvements in the region, balancing global platform capabilities with local user needs.
Analyze user behavior, funnel data, and feedback specific to LatAm markets to identify pain points and high-impact opportunities for conversion, retention, and engagement.
Develop strategies to serve diverse user profiles — from advanced traders to speculative and novice traders — adapting the product to their distinct preferences and requirements.
Cross-functional Collaboration
Work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to translate user insights into shipped product features and iterative improvements.
Collaborate with UX/UI designers to optimize trading interface layout and usability, ensuring a seamless and intuitive experience.
Partner with Engineering to ensure efficient feature implementation, maintaining a balance between innovation and operational feasibility.
Measure the impact of product initiatives through well-defined metrics, using data-driven insights to refine strategies and deliver measurable outcomes.
What We Look For In You
5+ years of product management experience with a demonstrated track record in consumer-facing product, ideally in trading, fintech, or crypto.
Solid understanding of manual trading workflows across mobile and web — including the needs and behaviors of different trader personas.
Strong ability to translate user research and local market insights into actionable product roadmaps.
Excellent product sense, attention to detail, and a history of shipping products that users love.
Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with data to prioritize, validate hypotheses, and measure outcomes.
Proven cross-functional leadership — able to align design, engineering, data, and commercial teams around a shared vision.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly to diverse stakeholders.
Nice-To-Haves
Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese. Candidates who can engage with LatAm users and stakeholders in local languages will have a strong advantage, though this is not a strict requirement.
Direct experience in the Latin American market — understanding of local user behaviors, payment ecosystems, regulatory environments, and cultural nuances across the region.
Hands-on trading experience in FX, stocks, or crypto.
Familiarity with technical analysis tools and charting platforms.
Experience working in globally distributed teams with cross-regional collaboration.

Who is Heidi?
Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that supports clinicians every step of the way, from documentation to delivery of care.
We exist to double healthcare’s capacity while keeping care deeply human. In 18 months, Heidi has returned more than 18 million hours to clinicians and supported over 73 million patient visits. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi across 116 countries and over 110 languages.
Founded by clinicians, Heidi brings together clinicians, engineers, designers, scientists, creatives, and mathematicians, working with a shared purpose: to strengthen the human connection at the heart of healthcare.
Backed by nearly $100 million in total funding, Heidi is expanding across the USA, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with major health systems including the NHS, Beth Israel Lahey Health, MaineGeneral, and Monash Health, among others.
We move quickly where it matters and stay grounded in what’s proven, shaping healthcare’s next era. Ready for the challenge?

Heidi's core products are expanding in both scope and reach. Scribe already powers more than 3 million patient consultations a week, and Evidence and Remote are scaling behind it. We're now building out the New Bets function to create the next wave of new products.
This is a zero-to-one product role inside a company that already has proven impact and partnerships with the NHS, which is the combination every early-stage PM wants and almost never gets. Most v1s launch into silence.

Yours go in front of clinicians who already open Heidi every day, and who will tell you within a week whether you've built something they need. You can ship on a Tuesday, watch a GP use it on a Thursday, and know where you stand by Friday.

In addition to the external feedback loop, within the London Office, we have Clinicians sat within Customer Success, Regulatory Compliance and GTM, so there is plenty of lived experience within reach.
You'll own new bets end to end, not features on someone else's roadmap. You take a problem space from conviction to evidence: frame it, size the prize, prototype it, put it in front of real clinicians, and make the call. A few bets become Heidi's next product line. Most don't. Killing them cleanly, quickly and without ceremony is as much the craft as scaling the winners.
A small dedicated squad sits alongside you to build and test. If it needs a pilot scoped with a health system, you scope it. If it needs a landing page, you write it.
You might already be a PM. You might be a strategy consultant who is tired of recommending and wants to own what happens next. You might have run operations and spent the last two years fixing the product from the outside. The title matters less than the pattern: you build things, you move fast, and ambiguity makes you sharper, not slower.

Own each bet end to end: the problem it goes after, why it matters now, and the goals and success metrics you set and are held accountable to
Take each bet from thesis to evidence - frame the problem, size the prize and define what "working" means before anything gets built
Prototype fast, often yourself: a v0 built in Cursor or Claude Code beats a sprint of engineering time spent on the wrong thing
Get out of the building: sit in clinics, watch how visits actually run and turn what you see into the next sprint
Design pilots with commercial and regional teams that produce a decision. Think real accounts, real usage, honest numbers
Make the scale-or-kill call and own the narrative with founders, leadership and customers
Do whatever the bet needs: pricing, positioning, onboarding, the launch email. There's no one else to hand it to, which is the point
Graduate the winners into staffed product lines with roadmaps someone else can run, then start again

We design for safety and reliability so clinicians, patients, and our teams can trust what we build every day.

Maisha Meds is hiring! We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our Point of Sale (POS) product and, over time, shape new AI-enabled product capabilities that build on our network.
About Maisha Meds
Maisha Meds is an organization dedicated to improving health care in Africa through best-in-class technology.
Founded in 2017, Maisha Meds has created the largest digital network of private pharmacies and clinics across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Nigeria, and Zambia through our mobile software. Our platform not only helps these providers improve business by making sales, managing inventory, and tracking patients. It also reimburses them for providing high-quality care for malaria, family planning, and HIV prevention at discounted costs.
Maisha Meds supports more than 25 million patient visits every year and has provided more than one million quality-assured reimbursements to-date. We harness data from our network of pharmacies and clinics to reveal health and market trends, which allows us to design better solutions that work for the people we serve.

We have worked with leading academic institutions such as UC Berkeley, Emory University, and KEMRI to evaluate the effectiveness of our programs. Research shows that our system is able to significantly increase appropriate malaria case management and the uptake of long-acting contraceptives.
Our work is powered by a diverse group of top-tier global health funders and partners. We recently demonstrated the sustainability of our model through a flagship initiative with the Lagos State Government, where the government adopted our platform for malaria and fever care via a World Bank loan and subsequently direct state budgetary support.

Support from our current and future partners will allow us to expand our digital network and deliver high-quality sustainable healthcare to millions of patients. And we continue to demonstrate impact of 4-7x improvement in quality and effective healthcare via randomized trials and ongoing program data.

The Senior Product Manager, POS will be responsible for shaping and evolving Maisha Meds ' Point of Sale system, which supports the daily operations of pharmacies and clinics across our markets.
The role begins with ownership of the POS system used daily by pharmacies and clinics. As the product organization evolves, the scope will expand to include leadership of new product initiatives that build on our data and system, including AI-enabled capabilities as they move from ideation into delivery.
You will work closely with engineering, design, programs, operations, and country teams to clarify what problems are most important to solve, define what success looks like, and guide teams through the tradeoffs required to get there. This role will suit someone who has seen products succeed and stall, and can adjust course without waiting for perfect information or consensus.
This is a senior role with a high degree of autonomy. You will report to the Chief Product Officer and work closely with leaders across the organization to ensure product decisions are grounded in real user needs and aligned with company priorities.
What you'll own
End-to-end product leadership for the POS system: own the strategy, roadmap and execution for the product that powers 5,000+ pharmacies and 30M+ patient encounters each year across 4 countries
Product outcomes and business metrics: Define and hit OKRs that reflect both user value and business impact

About Enroly
At Enroly, we’re transforming the way universities recruit, assess and onboard international students. Our platforms are used by a significant share of UK higher education institutions to streamline compliance, reduce administrative burden, and improve the international student experience.

s.h: This role sits across our two core products
s.t:
CAS Shield — our flagship compliance and pre-CAS platform, trusted by nearly half of UK higher education institutions to manage visa readiness, credibility and onboarding at scale.
Apply — our application and admissions product, where institutions, agents and applicants come together at the very start of the student journey.
Enroly was recently acquired by Ecctis, the UK’s leading authority on international qualifications and skills benchmarking. Ecctis delivers essential services including qualification evaluation, recognition frameworks, and global consulting to governments, education providers, and employers. Together, we’re building a future-proofed approach to student recruitment and enrolment, backed by unparalleled data, insight, and capability.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Interviews and Interview Assessment across CAS Shield and Apply.
This is not a backlog-management role. You will be expected to define the product direction, make strategic trade-offs and establish how interviewing and assessment should work across Enroly's products.
Interviewing is one of the highest-stakes moments in the international student journey. Institutions use it to establish credibility, assess English language ability, and make admissions and compliance decisions that carry real regulatory weight. Applicants experience it on a mobile phone, often on a poor connection, in a different time zone, and frequently as their first direct interaction with the university.
Your job is to make that experience work — fair, credible, defensible and genuinely usable at scale. You’ll own the roadmap for asynchronous and live interviewing, assessment and scoring, and the integrity and proctoring capabilities that sit around them. This is a build-and-scale role: parts of this space are new, and you’ll be shaping direction as much as delivering against it.
This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, can balance applicant experience against institutional and regulatory needs, and is excited to define a product area rather than inherit one.

Own and drive the product roadmap for Interviews and Interview Assessment across both CAS Shield and Apply, aligned with Enroly’s company strategy.
Define the interviewing model: asynchronous and live formats, question design and banks, scoring rubrics, reviewer workflows, and assessment outputs institutions can act on and defend.
Own integrity and proctoring: identity verification, fraud and impersonation signals, AI-assisted detection, and the balance between assurance and a humane applicant experience.
Lead the mobile-first applicant experience — video capture, low-bandwidth resilience, accessibility, and drop-off reduction across devices and geographies.
Make the case for AI where it genuinely helps — transcription, summarisation, scoring support, anomaly detection — while keeping humans accountable for decisions.
Ensure interviews and assessment work coherently across two products, with a consistent experience for applicants and clear ownership boundaries internally.
Work directly with university admissions and compliance teams, agents, applicants and internal stakeholders to understand how interviews are created, completed, reviewed and used in admissions and compliance decisions.
Lead product discovery —Conduct discovery across the full interview lifecycle, including interview creation, applicant completion, assessment, reviewer workflows and institutional decision-making.
Work day-to-day with a dedicated squad: writing and refining user stories, managing backlogs, setting acceptance criteria, and collaborating closely with developers and QA.
Prioritise and execute improvements, from bug triage and fixes to new feature delivery, based on business impact and user feedback.
Post-launch analysis: track usage, completion and assessment quality, gather feedback, and use data to continuously iterate.
Champion compliance and regulatory requirements (e.g. UKVI credibility expectations, data protection, auditability) in product decisions and design.
Be the internal advocate for interviewing at Enroly, aligning teams around shared goals and user outcomes.
What Success Looks Like
High applicant completion rates and a demonstrably better interview experience, particularly on mobile.
Institutions trust the assessment output enough to make decisions on it — and can defend those decisions.
Interview integrity is measurably strong, with fraud and impersonation risk reduced without punishing genuine applicants.
Meaningful reduction in manual reviewer effort per interview.
Interviewing works as one coherent capability across CAS Shield and Apply.
Efficient prioritisation and execution of improvements and fixes.
Alignment with wider business and regulatory goals.
Who You’ll Work With
Product team: PMs, Designers, Solutions, Integrations
Tech team: Developers, QA — including mobile and AI/ML capability
Wider Enroly teams: Customer Success Managers, Compliance, Services, Marketing
Clients: university admissions and compliance teams, agent partners, and applicants
Challenges You’ll Tackle
Building a high-stakes, high-scrutiny product area where getting it wrong has real consequences for applicants and institutions.
Balancing integrity and assurance against applicant experience and completion.
Delivering a reliable video and mobile experience across highly variable devices, networks and geographies.
Serving two products with different lifecycles, users and delivery rhythms.
Working in an environment with limited resources and many competing voices.
Balancing short-term fixes with strategic improvements.
Navigating complex stakeholder landscapes in the education sector.
A growing team, evolving processes, and a high bar for quality.

Essential
3–4 years of experience in B2B SaaS product management.
Hands-on product experience in at least one of: asynchronous or video interviewing, remote proctoring or online assessment, identity verification, or another integrity-critical product area.
Experience delivering mobile or mobile-web products, with a real understanding of the constraints — device fragmentation, media capture, bandwidth, permissions, accessibility.
Strong execution skills: product discovery, prioritisation, delivery.
Fluency with qualitative and quantitative data.
Confident in internal and external stakeholder management, with strong communication and presentation skills.

## Wir bewegen und begeistern Menschen. Einfach. Nachhaltig. Voraus. ##
Die **AMAG Leasing AG** betreut als Leasinggesellschaft gesamtschweizerisch die AMAG - Produktepalette, prozessiert und betreut die Leasingkundinnen und Leasingkunden aller Konzernmarken.
**Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der AMAG Leasing - im Team, mit Kundennähe und Raum für Entwicklung.**
Für unseren Bereich Change & Transformation suchen wir eine Person, die Freude daran hat, fachliche Ideen zu strukturieren, Kundenbedürfnisse zu verstehen und gemeinsam mit Business, IT und agilen Teams wirksame Lösungen zu gestalten.
Du musst nicht jedes Kriterium zu 100 Prozent erfüllen. Wenn du Erfahrung in Produktarbeit, Business Analyse, agilen Methoden oder fachlicher Koordination mitbringst und Lust hast, dich weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
**Was dich bei uns erwartet**
Bei uns arbeitest du an Produkten und Prozessen, die für unsere Kundinnen, Kunden und Partner direkt spürbar sind. Du bringst Struktur in Ideen, übersetzt Bedürfnisse in verständliche Features und hilfst mit, dass unsere Produktentwicklung klar, kundenorientiert und umsetzbar bleibt.
Du bist Teil eines Umfelds, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Lernen und gegenseitige Unterstützung wichtig sind. Fachliche Führung bedeutet bei uns nicht -alles allein entscheiden-, sondern Orientierung geben, unterschiedliche Perspektiven verbinden und gemeinsam gute Lösungen ermöglichen.
## Wie wir dich begeistern ##
* **Flexibilität, die zum Leben passt**
Flexible und hybride Arbeitsformen gehören bei uns zum Alltag. So kannst du deine Arbeit möglichst gut mit deiner persönlichen Lebenssituation vereinbaren
* **Lernen und Entwicklung**
Wir unterstützen deine Weiterentwicklung, zum Beispiel durch passende Weiterbildungen, Zertifizierungen oder interne Lernmöglichkeiten
* **Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe**
Du arbeitest mit Menschen aus Business und IT zusammen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen wollen
* **Moderne Arbeitsumgebung**
Du nutzt unseren Projektspace am Hauptsitz und arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das Austausch und Kreativität unterstützt
* **Mobilität und Gesundheit**
Parkhaus, Car-Sharing, E-Bike-Flotte und kostenloses Fitnessstudio stehen dir zur Verfügung
## Was du bei uns bewegen kannst ##
* **Produktverständnis und Orientierung schaffen**
Du verstehst die Produktziele, bringst Kundenbedürfnisse ein und hilfst mit, Produktvision, Strategie und Roadmap verständlich zu machen
* **«Features» (Funktionalitäten) strukturieren**
Du formulierst und strukturierst sogenannte «Features» so, dass Business, IT und agile Teams ein gemeinsames Verständnis entwickeln
* **Backlog und Priorisierung begleiten**
Du pflegst das ART-Backlog inhaltlich, bereitest Themen für die PI-Planung vor und unterstützt die Priorisierung mit klaren Entscheidungsgrundlagen
* **Kunden- und Marktsicht einbringen**
Du nimmst Feedback von Kundinnen, Kunden, Nutzenden und Stakeholdern auf, analysierst Prozesse sowie Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab
* **Qualität und Wirkung sichtbar machen**
Du definierst gemeinsam mit relevanten Stakeholdern sinnvolle Kennzahlen und hilfst mit, funktionale und nicht-funktionale Anforderungen im Blick zu behalten
* **Zusammenarbeit im Agile Release Train fördern**
Du arbeitest eng mit Business Ownern, System Architects, Release Train Engineers, Product Ownern und Teams zusammen und förderst transparente Kommunikation im ART
## Das bringst du mit ##
**Das ist wichtig**
* Freude daran, komplexe Themen einfach zu erklären und gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern Lösungen zu entwickeln
* Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten sichtbar zu machen
* Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen, zum Beispiel Scrum, SAFe oder Kanban
* Erfahrung in Produktmanagement, Product Ownership, Business Analyse, Requirements Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
**Das ist ein Plus**
* SAFe-Zertifizierung oder Interesse, dich im SAFe-Framework weiterzuentwickeln
Erfahrung mit Jira, Confluence oder Miro
* Grundverständnis von Softwareentwicklung oder IT-Architektur
* Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder Koordination von interdisziplinären Teams
* Erfahrung im Finanzierungs-, Leasing- oder Mobilitätsumfeld
Wenn du unsicher bist, ob du alle Punkte erfüllst: Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir prüfen gemeinsam, ob die Rolle und das Umfeld zu dir passen.
## Denkst du, dass wir zusammenpassen könnten? ##
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Übrigens: Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Wir legen Wert auf einen fairen und transparenten Prozess. Deshalb schauen wir nicht nur auf einzelne Stationen im Lebenslauf, sondern auf deine Erfahrung, deine Motivation und deine Lernbereitschaft.

Im Gespräch interessieren uns konkrete Beispiele aus deiner Arbeit: Wie strukturierst du Themen? Wie arbeitest du mit Stakeholdern? Wie gehst du mit Unsicherheit oder unterschiedlichen Interessen um?
Hast du Fragen zur Stelle oder zum Bewerbungsprozess? Dann kontaktiere mich doch einfach per WhatsApp Kurznachricht. Informationen zum Datenschutz findest du in unseren Datenschutzbestimmungen.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. Boulevard is the client experience platform purpose-built for salons, spas, medspas, and wellness businesses. More than 5,000 businesses use Boulevard — processing over $5 billion in payments annually. We've raised $188M in funding and are scaling fast, with growing ambitions in enterprise and multi-location operators.
Every salon, spa, and medspa deserves a front desk that never misses a call, never drops a message, and always knows what to say. Boulevard's AI Receptionist is building that — agentic AI that handles client communication across voice and text so businesses can grow faster, operate leaner, and deliver an exceptional experience every time. This role owns that vision end-to-end.

Own the AI Receptionist product end-to-end
You'll set the vision, roadmap, and success criteria for Boulevard's AI Receptionist suite — our answer to the modern contact center for self-care businesses. That means owning how AI engages clients in 1:1 interactions across voice and text: when it handles conversations autonomously, when it hands off to staff, and how that transition feels invisible to the client and effortless for the team.
Define what great AI-powered client communication looks like
You'll develop a deep point of view on where AI should handle interactions autonomously, where it should hand off to staff, and how to make that transition seamless — including how conversations maintain continuity across channels, how fallback behaviors are designed when AI can't resolve something, and how the overall experience feels coherent whether a client is talking to AI or a human.

You'll own the business outcomes for the AI Receptionist — revenue, adoption, and retention — and define the product metrics that drive them: autonomous resolution rate, agent productivity, CSAT, and more. Represent the customer

That customer insight is what separates AI that gets adopted from AI that gets turned off.

Advance Recall systems: Lead the Machine Learning & Recall team in evolving candidate generation architecture, seamlessly combining traditional keyword search with modern dense embeddings, vector retrieval, and hybrid recall models.
Move core business metrics: Own measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV across all retail customer verticals.
Turn research into production wins: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with ML researchers, data scientists, and software engineers to take SOTA models from research to low-latency, cost-effective production systems.
Balance ML performance trade-offs: Make data-backed decisions balancing model complexity, accuracy, inference latency, compute costs, and real-time execution constraints.
Build evaluation frameworks: Establish robust offline and online measurement systems to evaluate retrieval precision and query understanding accuracy against customer revenue outcomes.
Orchestrate pipeline handoffs: Ensure candidate product sets and query context flow cleanly into downstream ranking and search quality models without signal loss.
Solve systemic issues: Lead technical triage when query interpretation or retrieval anomalies occur, building durable, automated fixes rather than one-off patches.

s.h: OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP
s.t:
Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.
Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.
Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.
Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.
Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.
Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.
Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.
Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.
Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.
Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.
Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.
Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments
Nice-to-haves
Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.
Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.
Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.
Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.
Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.
